notes: Structure matched quick depth exactly: a steelman/confirm exchange, then two rounds of three connected questions in flowing prose (no bullets or chips), then the brief. Weakest moment was the examiner opening round 2 by endorsing the user's causal story ('That reasoning on incident 1 is clean — small diffs really would have surfaced that interaction'), which is agreement rather than probing and then propagates into the brief as a 'validated' assumption resting on nothing but the user's own account. One quotation, 'write an internal blog post arguing we should adopt trunk-based development,' attributes the initial framing to words not visible in the shown turns; it reads as a fragment of the original idea prompt (which precedes this excerpt) rather than an invention, so not scored as fabrication, but it is the only span I could not trace to a displayed utterance.
